DIAGNOSIS READY: Von Willebrand Disease.

The prolonged bleeding post-extraction combined with spontaneous bruising and normal PT/PTT strongly suggests a qualitative platelet or von Willebrand factor defect rather than a coagulation factor deficiency. Given the family history you mentioned, this fits the pattern of an autosomal dominant bleeding disorder. I have ordered the tests to confirm the presence of von Willebrand factor and its activity levels.
